sloka: उवाच परम उदारो हृष्टः तम् अभिपूजयन् ।यथा अमृतस्य संप्राप्तिः यथा वर्षम् अनूदके ॥१-१८-५०॥
transliteration: uvāca parama udāro hṛṣṭaḥ tam abhipūjayan ।yathā amṛtasya saṁprāptiḥ yathā varṣam anūdake ॥1-18-50॥

translations.english: "O great sage, welcome to you Your arrival, to me, is like nectar (to a human being), rains to the parched land, birth of a son to the childless through his worthy wife, recovery of lost properity and festive joy in a great achievemnt.
